stemMarkdown: A boat travels downstream at 18 km/h and upstream at 12 km/h. Find the speed (in km/h) of the boat in still water.
solutionMarkdown: Downstream speed is boat $+$ stream and upstream is boat $-$ stream. Adding the two cancels the stream: boat speed $= \dfrac{18 + 12}{2} = 15$ km/h.
altSolutionMarkdown: Subtracting instead gives the stream speed: $\dfrac{18 - 12}{2} = 3$ km/h.
